PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT 4672 - inference-runtime-high-5xx - triggered 2026-03-14T23:41:39Z. page: @oncall-primary. link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4672
Sara: i'm on it, just landed at my hotel — ETA 10m. grabbing initial triage.
Ben: ok if you need me to pick up the midnight window (00:00-04:00 UTC) i can. I'm in EU timezone.
Sara: thanks @Ben — primary right now. brief: spike in KV cache misses -> 503s on 4 workers. customers: small subset of hosted customers, higher latency and failed completions.
Aisha: is this the same pattern as last month? any overlap with autoscaler flapping?
Sara: looks different; logs show LRU churn and sudden mem pressure on worker-3 and worker-7. autoscaler didn't trigger because worker CPU stayed low.
Dmitri: runbook note: if it's cache blowout, try toggling prefix_cache:false for the affected model-route and then restart worker. see runbook: https://redwood.io/runbooks/inference-high-errors
Marco: can someone add quick customer-impact note for support? they asked for RCA asap.
Sara: adding a short note: "Partial delivery failures to 3% of inference requests for model 'open-llama-13b' in us-west-2. No data exfiltration. Mitigation in progress." @support-team
Ben: i'm happy to cover the 00:00-04:00UTC window if Sara needs handoff at 00:05. @Sara please ack.
Sara: ack. i'll try the non-destructive mitigation first: increase KV-cache size to 1.5x on worker-3 and juggle routing away from worker-7. doing it now.
PagerDuty Bot: deploy request by Sara approved. CI pipeline started: build/5719. logs: https://redwood.ci/build/5719
Aisha: if that doesn't take, plan B is rolling restart of the inference-shard with `shardctl drain && shardctl restart --grace 60` per runbook.
Sara: cache resize applied, tailing logs:
```
worker-3 cache_size=768MB -> 1152MB
kv_evictions: 130/s -> 4/s
5xx_rate: 12% -> 3% and dropping
```
Dmitri: nice. keep an eye for regression in latency.
Marco: Ben, once Sara does handoff, please paste handoff summary here and include pagerduty note so support knows who's primary.
Ben: will do. Sara — if you don't mind, i'll take the formal primary now at 00:05 UTC. short checklist i'll follow:
 - confirm 5xx <= 1% for 15m
 - verify autoscaler health
 - ensure no resurgence of kv_evictions
 - post update to #support
Sara: handing off at 00:05 — summary: cache resize fixed immediate pressure, rollout in progress, customers impacted reduced to 0.5% failed requests. Ben takes primary. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ben: on call. I'm primary until 04:00 UTC. contacting support now. posting brief: "Primary: Ben. Incident 4672 mitigation in progress, partial failures reduced. I'll escalate if >1% failure for 10m." @support-team
PagerDuty Bot: NOTE: secondary oncall assigned: Aisha. escalation rule intact.
Aisha: standing by. if Ben needs a quick live-debug ping, DM me. also adding runbook pointer to the incident doc.
Marco: leaving a quick customer impact entry in the incident tracker: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4672/notes
Ben: closing out here for now—monitoring. will reopen thread if anything changes.
